'''Lunae Minx''' was a young [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] clubgoer [[Homeworld/Legends|from]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. She was a sultry temptress who was a regular at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Minx often visited the club to say hello to her acquaintance [[Ayy Vida/Legends|Ayy Vida]], a fellow Twi'lek.

During a [[Local day/Legends|night]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Minx stood at a table in the Outlander and talked with the [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Achk Med-Beq/Legends|Achk Med-Beq]] and Vida when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] entered looking for [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]]. Skywalker was briefly distracted by her dazzling looks before going back to searching for Wesell. When the bounty hunter was disarmed by Kenobi, Minx, Vida and Med-Beq turned to stare.

==Biography==
Lunae Minx was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to<ref name="DB" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Ryloth">{{SWE|locations|ryloth|Ryloth}}</ref> [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="DB" /> Minx was a young<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> clubgoer<ref name="Delegation">{{InsiderCite|85|Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000}}</ref> and a sultry temptress who used her charms to reel in would-be lovers.<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|96|OUT 1-2|Outlander Nightclub Patrons}}</ref> During the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], she was a regular at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="DB" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]]<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CSWE2" /> Minx was an acquaintance of<ref name="DB" /> the Twi'lek dancer and [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]<ref name="Mini">{{SWMiniCite|set=Bounty Hunters|pack=Ayy Vida}}</ref> [[Ayy Vida/Legends|Ayy Vida]]<ref name="DB" /> and the con-artist<ref name="DBAyy">{{DB|character|ayyvida|Vida, Ayy}}</ref> [[Achk Med-Beq/Legends|Achk Med-Beq]].<ref name="DB" /> Minx and other Twi'leks often visited the Outlander Club to say hello to Vida.<ref name="FF" />

[[File:MinxAndMed-Beq-AOTC.png|thumb|left|375px|Minx looked back at Anakin Skywalker as he walked away.]]
During a [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Minx drank and stood at a table in the Outlander Club with Vida, Med-Beq,<ref name="AOTC" /> the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Ren-Quarr]],<ref name="Insider" /> a [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]], and two [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="AOTC" /> The Twi'leks and Med-Beq had an<ref name="AOTC" /> impromptu<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}}</ref> chat and as they did, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] walked by their table. He and his master, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], were in the club, searching for the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] after an [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] on the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="AOTC" /> 

Minx caught his [[Eye/Legends|eye]] and the padawan was briefly distracted by her dazzling looks. After focusing back on the task at hand,<ref name="FF" /> he walked away from the table with Minx looking back at him. Skywalker walked by the table again, and shortly thereafter, Wesell was disarmed with Kenobi's [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's second lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], causing Minx, Vida, and Med-Beq to glance at the situation. The Padawan told the clubgoers to go back to their drinks and the group left the club.<ref name="AOTC" /> While the Jedi interrogated Wesell outside, both Vida and Med-Beq had left Minx and ventured off to different parts of the club.<ref name="Complete Locations" />

==Personality and traits==
Minx was acquainted with Ayy Vida and Achk Med-Beq.<ref name="DB" /> The Twi'lek used her considerable charms to attract would-be lovers. When she caught Anakin Skywalker's eye, he was briefly distracted by her dazzling looks.<ref name="FF" /> Thought to be truly stunning,<ref name="FF" /> The Twi'lek possessed [[Color/Legends|brown]] eyes and was distinguished by her light purple skin<ref name="DB" /> that had mottled dark purple spots that went along her [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]] and down her arms.<ref name="AOTC" /> Her skin color was considered quite rare for her [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="DB" />

==Equipment==
Minx wore a floor-length black [[Clothing/Legends|dress]] and a silver headress on her visit to the Outlander Club<ref name="AOTC" /> in 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="NEC" /> She also carried with her two cloth accessories she draped around her arms.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I was purple in [Episode II] and it took about six hours to do! My call time was at 3 a.m., and my makeup took until 7 a.m., and we wouldn't start shooting until two hours after that. The makeup went all down my arm and they airbrushed spots down the tentacles. I was exhausted by the end of the day.|Katie Lucas, reminiscing the filming of ''Attack of the Clones''|<ref name="Katie Lucas">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/bts/profile/f20051221/index.html|text=The Force Runs Strong In This Family: Jett, Amanda & Katie}}</ref>}}
Lunae Minx was created for the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="Katie Lucas" /> which released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> [[Katie Lucas]], daughter of ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]], portrayed Minx and designed the character's costume with help from<ref name="Katie Lucas" /> costume designer<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Trisha Biggar]].<ref name="Katie Lucas" /> Lucas was shown photos for design, and knowing her character would be in a nightclub, wanted something "sexy". She also wanted her character to be an [[Alien/Legends|alien]], thinking the idea was cool.<ref name="Katie Lucas" /> 

[[File:Lunae.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Lunae Minx, Ayy Vida, and [[Sel Maa]] in a promotional photo.]]
Shooting for the Outlander Club scenes started on [[July 17]], [[2000]] at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> Lucas's call time was three am, and her makeup application&mdash;which had airbrushing done on the character's lekku and makeup going all the way down her arms&mdash;took until 7 am, with shooting filming starting two hours after that. Lucas ended up exhausted at the end of filming.<ref name="Katie Lucas" /> Minx and other patrons of the Outlander Club were named by George Lucas and his film production company, [[Lucasfilm]], during the production of the movie.<ref name="crc">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> Minx was first revealed when Lucas, in costume, introduced the twenty-third episode of the Episode II behind-the-scenes video series [[On location|''on location'']].<ref name="on location">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/23.html|series=On Location|text=Part 23 - R2-D2's Don}}</ref> The episode, "R2-D2's Don," was released on [[January 2]], [[2001]].<ref name="Archive">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/archive.html|text=''on location'' archive}}</ref>

The character would make her first appearance in an illustration in ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Movie Storybook]]'', authored by both [[Jane Mason]] and [[Sarah Hines Stephens|Sarah Stephens Hines]]<ref name="Storybook">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Movie Storybook]]''</ref> and released on [[April 23]], [[2002]].<ref name="storybookDate">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/young/news20020225.html|text=Book Preview: Episode II Children's Books}}</ref> Lunae Minx was first identified in [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entries for Ayy Vida and Achk Med-Beq<ref name="DBBeq">{{DB|character|achkmedbeq|Med-Beq, Achk}}</ref><ref name="DBAyy" /> posted on [[June 14]], 2002,<ref name="Coruscant Nightlife">{{SWArchive|url=databank/news/2002/06/news20020614.html|text=Coruscant Nightlife}}</ref> though she was at one point known to fans as "Nabrina Smoo."<ref name="DWW">{{SW|url=news/die-wanna-wanga-encounters-of-the-twilek-kind|text=Die Wanna Wanga: Encounters of The Twi'lek Kind|nolive=1}}</ref> In the StarWars.com article "[[Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases]]," published on [[May 2]], [[2003]], Minx is identified as "Nabrina Smoo" in an image in the article but is referred to as Lunae Minx within the text.<ref name="crc" />
